notes: `createStore(reducer, compose(applyMiddleware(...)))`: the enhancer builds the store through `enhancer(createStore)(reducer, undefined)`, so a root reducer that inspects its state (redux-persist's `persistReducer` reads `state._persist`) runs `@@redux/INIT` on `undefined`, not on the enhancer, and its slice keys pick the recorded store. `compose(f, g)(x)` is `f(g(x))`.
